map.del(17p)、t(4;14)、t(14;16)、t(14;20) 为 ISS: del(17p), t(4;14), t(14;16), t(14;20) are high-risk cytogenetic abnormalities in ISS/R-ISS
map.ISS I + LDH正常 + 无高危遗传学: ISS I + normal LDH + no high-risk genetics
map.ISS III + LDH升高 和/或 高危遗传学: ISS III + raised LDH and/or high-risk genetics
map.提示：R-ISS在ISS基础上整合LDH和高危FISH，更准确预测预后。1q扩增: Note: R-ISS adds LDH and high-risk FISH to ISS for more accurate prognosis. 1q amplification is also listed as intermediate-high risk in the newer Mayo mSMART. For clinical reference.
map.📚 深度解析：多发性骨髓瘤 R-ISS 分期器: 📚 Deep Dive: Multiple Myeloma R-ISS Staging Tool
map.初诊 MM 按 ISS（β2-MG、白蛋白）+ LDH + 高危 FISH 定: For newly diagnosed MM, assign R-ISS stage by ISS (β2-MG, albumin) + LDH + high-risk FISH.
map.用 R-ISS 沟通中位总生存与危险度（I 未达到 / II 约 83 / II: Use R-ISS to communicate median overall survival and risk (I not reached / II ~83 / III ~43 months).
map.结合 1q21 扩增等中高危标志综合判断: Combine intermediate-high risk markers such as 1q21 amplification for an integrated judgement.
map.ISS：β2-MG<3.5 且白蛋白≥35 g/L 为 I；β2-MG≥5.5: ISS: β2-MG <3.5 and albumin ≥35 g/L is I; β2-MG ≥5.5 is III; between is II. R-ISS integrates LDH and cytogenetics on ISS: high-risk FISH = del(17p), t(4;14), t(14;16), t(14;20). R-ISS I = ISS I and normal LDH and no high-risk genetics; III = ISS III and raised LDH and/or high-risk genetics; the rest is II.
map.例1（β2-MG=2.8、白蛋白=42 g/L、LDH 正常、无高危 FISH）: Example 1 (β2-MG=2.8, albumin=42 g/L, normal LDH, no high-risk FISH): ISS I + normal LDH + no high-risk → R-ISS I (median OS not reached). Example 2 (β2-MG=6.0, albumin=30, raised LDH, del(17p)): ISS III + raised LDH and high-risk → R-ISS III (median OS ~43 months).
map.R-ISS 比 ISS 好在哪？: Where is R-ISS better than ISS?
map.R-ISS 加入 LDH 与高危细胞遗传学，把「同 ISS 但预后不同」的患者分: R-ISS adds LDH and high-risk cytogenetics to separate patients who share ISS but differ in prognosis, giving finer risk distinction; it is one of the mainstream standards for MM prognosis communication.
map.1q21 扩增在 Mayo mSMART 等新版中列为中高危，但在经典 R-IS: 1q21 amplification is listed as intermediate-high risk in newer versions such as Mayo mSMART, but is not directly in the classic R-ISS high-risk FISH; if combined with other adverse factors the overall risk should be raised, and interpretation follows the centre and version.

map.多发性骨髓瘤R-ISS修订版国际分期系统器，根据白蛋白、β2微球蛋白、LDH和高: A multiple myeloma R-ISS revised international staging tool: it assigns R-ISS stage from albumin, β2-microglobulin, LDH and high-risk cytogenetics. A professional medical tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
